lines.speaker: Lanipator
lines.text: We here at Team Four Star have always promoted supporting the official release.

lines.speaker: Lanipator
lines.text: It's the best way to make sure we'll be able to continue to enjoy all the great shows we know and love, and thanks to our friends over at Crunchyroll, supporting the official release has never been easier.

lines.speaker: Lanipator
lines.text: Through Crunchyroll, you can stream episodes of Jojo's Bizarre Adventure, Drifters, Keijo, and yes, Dragon Ball Super just *hours* after they air over in the Land of the Rising Sun.

lines.speaker: Lanipator
lines.text: So head on over to crunchyroll.com/teamfourstar now to begin your free trial.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Man, it feels like years since you and I just went fishing and chilled out.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: And of all times, right before a tournament to decide the fate of the world...

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Weird how stuff works out, am I right?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Nobody knows the weight on my shoulders.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Before I go to bed, when I wake up in the morning...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Sometimes, I wonder... Can I do this?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Wow, I, uh... I had no idea this Cell stuff was getting to you so badly.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Ever since I got out of the Chamber!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: In and out, day in and day out!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: She'll send Gohan for groceries five counties over in the middle of the day just to get him out of the house!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: You... know you can say "no", right?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And I never back down from a challenge.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Mom sent me to tell you to come home.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: She also told me to pick up a lot of... peanut butter?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Look, if you're asking me to tag in, I'm willing but—

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Catch more fish while I'm gone!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Oh, duh! Of course, like that'd ever work...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yeah, no, it... But if you had a wig...

lines.speaker: Presenter
lines.text: And now, introducing your World Martial Arts Champion, the strongest man on the planet... Misteeeeeer... SATAAAAAAN!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Uh, did we miss a tournament?!

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Yeah, there was one last month.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Damn it, we were busy training for the Androids!

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: What do either of you care?

lines.speaker: Presenter
lines.text: Mr. Satan, what do you have to say to your opponent?

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: I know why you gave everyone a week to prepare for your *little tournament*!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: It's so you could spend the last seven days on Earth prayin'... that MR. SATAN WOULDN'T SHOW UP!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: So after I eat my Jimmy John's, and drink my HETAP, AND F*** MY HOT ASIAN WIFE...!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: I'm gonna squash you like the bug... you... are.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: So... do they know what's going on with his name, or—

lines.speaker: Crowd
lines.text: HAIL SATAN! HAIL SATAN! HAIL SATAN! HAIL SATAN!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Guys! I need help with my hot Asian wife!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Who told you you could LEAVE THE BEDROOM?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Guys... don't tell her I'm here...!

lines.speaker: Crew Leader
lines.text: Dude, pull your balls out of your purse, and do your job.

lines.speaker: Crew Leader
lines.text: And do you know what's standing out there?

lines.speaker: Crew Leader
lines.text: A Pulitzer! Now go get it!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Hello, there! How may I help you?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Oh, please now... don't be so formal!

lines.speaker: Journalist
lines.text: Can you tell the audience where you are and who you came from?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: No, actually, an *apt* choice of words!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: As for the "where", this is the immaculate Cell Games Arena.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Let me weave you the tale of my origin.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Though I must preface that it does drag on in places, so I'll try to minimize the filler.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Now... our story begins as many stories often do: With a young girl shooting a little boy in the face.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Uh-huh... I didn't get a wink last night.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Chi-Chi keeps trying to break my record of nine times.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: "Go for ten," she yells... "GO for TEN!"

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I feel like a man dying of thirst watching another man drown.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, you know what they say:

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: A Saiyan gets stronger every time he comes... (Yawn) ...back from the brink of death.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: She's looking for something in the other room.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: 'Come on, I know we had another bottle of it somewhere around here.'

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: 'I will use canola oil if I have—'

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: So why don't you just... I don't know, "strategically withdraw"?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: She said she needs ALL of it.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I MEANT, just disappear for a little bit to recharge your... "batteries".

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, it is strategy... but we can't use the back door.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Chi-Chi says I'm not allowed to anymore.

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: 'And you're never going to get better unless you try.'

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: So... uh... do you hate your dad?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Ehh, you know, I wouldn't say I hate him.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I guess I'm mostly just disappointed.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: He's the single most frustrating man I've ever met.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Heh... but you know dads, right?

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'Oh, perfect! He's just as bad as you are.'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Please tell me nobody here wants a piece of me.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Uhh, well, when Dad's out of the Chamber, he'll probably want a swing at you.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Why did you bring us both along?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Because if your mother questioned you, you'd *talk*.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: So, Piccolo! How's the Time Chamber?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I don't want to talk about it.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Yeaaaah, probably not going to bother going in myself.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: At this point, either you guys can beat Cell or you can't.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: No use risking my life without the reset button on hand.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Wow... I hadn't even thought about that.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: We live in a world without Dragon Balls now!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Oh, yeah. That sounds terrible... I'm so sorry.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I don't get it. Why can't *you* just make us some new Dragon Balls, Piccolo?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Because, Goku, I'm from the warrior clan. *Kami* was from the dragon clan.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: One punches people; the other makes Dragon Balls.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Wait, but you two come from the same pers—

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: *So*, if you want Dragon Balls, you need another Namekian.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I bet there's a whole gaggle of Namekians who can make us a new set.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: We'd have to *find* New Namek first, and who knows where that is!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, what would you call them?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: A cornucopia. What do you call a group of humans?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Point is, without a Namekian from the dragon clan, we aren't getting any Dragon Ball—

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And so it turns out... *he was an alien the whole time*!

lines.speaker: Journalist
lines.text: *Whoa*! I did not see that coming!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Right?! So, two more Saiyans show up a year later...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Enter: Vegeta. Now... (Chuckle), strap yourself in for this cartoon character!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Hey, Dad? Can you come take a look at this?

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: What is it, pumpkin? Find Gero's *porn stash*~?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: It was completely inaccessible to him, and it's full of incomplete and corrupted files.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: But there's one undamaged video here.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Wait... why does that date sound familiar?
Hey, Dad. I, uh... I'm here at headquarters, getting everything put away.
No bunkmate, so... room to myself... which is good for a guy my size.
I just wanted to, you know... record something for you, since you and Uncle Frap are busy building robot guys and stuff.
I know you're calling them "artificial humans" now, but... that name is way too long.
Like, from that movie we saw?
Well, uh... just wanted you to know that I... miss you, Dad.

lines.speaker: Soldier
lines.text: Some *thing* is tearing its way through the compound!
Uhh... okay, sorry about this, Dad.

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Yeah, that's a hell of a bomb to drop.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: By the way, you owe me Ƶ5,000.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: ...And that's why we need you, Dende.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Okay, let me just clarify what has happened: THAT asshole—

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: —literally kidnapped me from across the entire galaxy, with neither my knowledge or consent, just so you could make me mystic you up a new set of Dragon Balls!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Because you are all a cavalcade of f***-ups.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: And what do I get out of this? Going to make me your king?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, can't do that; King's a dog.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: But we can make you God, though!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: I mean, what the f***'s a dog?!

lines.speaker: Popo
lines.text: As the creator of the Dragon Balls, you shall assume the throne of Kami, Guardian of this planet.

lines.speaker: Popo
lines.text: Nobody is thankful, there are no days off, and no one ever visits.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Ugh, sounds like being a parent...

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Fine. I graciously accept the position of your almighty God.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: No, bowlcut! I'm going to help Gohan.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Speaking of whom... lovin' the new 'do, Gohan.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: And, uh, have you been hitting the gym? 'Cause, uh...

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: That hurt me more than it hurt you.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Okay, I'm all for awkward reunions, but we are on a timetable here.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: How long will it take to make a new Dragon?

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Uh, depends. Do you have the original sculpture around?

lines.speaker: Popo
lines.text: Here it is. We were using it as a paperweight.

lines.speaker: Popo
lines.text: Which reminds me: We'll need to go over the contract later.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Our Dragon would literally wear him like a scarf.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Okay, before I get started: Any alterations?

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: I can give you two, though.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: It's a magical wish-granting dragon, Nail! I don't make the rules!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Man, all this lore we're learning today, and we even get to see a new Dragon being made!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: This is going to be awes—

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: HEY, DRAGON, WAKE THE F*** UP!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: IT'S ALREADY PAST NOON! GET YOUR *LIFE* TOGETHER!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: By the way, two wishes means I had to nix immortality.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Better that way—nobody pulling any more of that Freeza *shit*.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Huh. I wonder if that'll upset Vegeta.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Wait... did you say he's still in the Chamber?

lines.speaker: Popo
lines.text: Oh, I muted the time dilation in the Chamber.

lines.speaker: Popo
lines.text: One day out here is now one day in there.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: You really like screwin' with people, don't cha?

lines.speaker: Popo
lines.text: Of course, his first mistake was going in alone.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: THEY ALL CALLED ME CRAZY for letting him achieve his perfect form!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I'm going to get out of here!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I'M GOING TO BE SO MUCH STRONGER!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: *NO ONE WILL BE ABLE TO STOP ME*!! ESPECIALLY CELL!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: So after everything, he just starts *crying*!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: But, sadly, Vegeta does come back.

lines.speaker: Journalist
lines.text: By the way, does the fat green one come back?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You know in those cartoons where the guy in the desert finds a faucet, and it just comes out like...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And speaking of balls, I need to go find a dragon's.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: I took a test this morning.

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: And so I told him, "Pull your pants up, man," "I'm not that kind of doctor!"

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Also, I need the Dragon Radar.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Tool cabinet in the back, third drawer.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Bee-tee-dubs, we have Dragon Balls again.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Wait, we didn't have Dragon Balls?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Okay, so Article Five says that atrocities can *and will* be committed in your name... but you can't do anything about it.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Do I have to answer all of these prayers?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Well, technically, you don't have to answer any of them.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Or I guess I should start saying... me.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Oh Gohan, you can call me whatever you like.

lines.speaker: Popo
lines.text: Well, I'm going to call you Little Green.
Mr. Popo literally cracks a smile

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I'm his best friend, so that means only *I* can call him Little Green, right, Little Gree—

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: So after I finished humiliating the entire Saiyan royal bloodline, I made my newsroom debut, delivered my immaculate address, and now... here we are.

lines.speaker: Journalist
lines.text: Were the parts about fake Namek and that Maron girl really necessary to the story?

lines.speaker: Journalist
lines.text: *How* did you know about the parts you weren't there for?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Ah, that's a story for another time, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: But for now, I must bid you adieu.

lines.speaker: Journalist
lines.text: Well, thank you for your time, Perfect Cell.

segments.title: It's a Challenge, Krillin
segments.quote: You... know you can say "no", right? / But it's a *challenge*, Krillin! ... Also, it feels really good! Have you ever tried it? / Like... with a real person?

segments.title: Mr. Satan's Hot Asian Wife
segments.quote: So after I eat my Jimmy John's, and drink my HETAP, AND F*** MY HOT ASIAN WIFE...! I'm gonna squash you like the bug... you... are.

segments.title: HAIL SATAN!
segments.quote: So... do they know what's going on with his name, or— / HAIL SATAN! HAIL SATAN! / ...Okay, yeah, they know.

segments.title: MISTER Perfect Cell
segments.quote: Call me "Perfect Cell". / Uh... okay. Perfect Cell— / MISTER Perfect Cell!

segments.title: GO for TEN!
segments.quote: Chi-Chi keeps trying to break my record of nine times. "Go for ten," she yells... "GO for TEN!" / I feel like a man dying of thirst watching another man drown.

segments.title: Piccolo Makes Small Talk
segments.quote: So... uh... do you hate your dad? ... Heh... but you know dads, right? / Goku killed mine.

segments.title: Sorry About This, Dad
segments.quote: Just wanted you to know that I... miss you, Dad. ... Got to run. Love you. Good luck with your cybor— / ...*Jesus*!

segments.title: The F***'s a God?
segments.quote: The f***'s a god? I mean, what the f***'s a dog?! I mean, what the f***?!

segments.title: HEY DRAGON, WAKE THE F*** UP!
segments.quote: HEY, DRAGON, WAKE THE F*** UP! IT'S ALREADY PAST NOON! GET YOUR *LIFE* TOGETHER!

segments.title: RIGHT, NAPPA?!
segments.quote: NO ONE WILL BE ABLE TO STOP ME!! ESPECIALLY CELL! RIGHT, NAPPA?! ... Showed him.

segments.title: Bulma! Sex Makes Babies!
segments.quote: Bulma! Sex makes babies! / ...I'm well aware. ... Bee-tee-dubs, we have Dragon Balls again. Bye!

segments.title: Super Kami Dende
segments.quote: You will call me Dende! DENDE! SAY IT! Say my name! / Dende! DENDE! / No... *Super Kami Dende*.
